title: T Cell Cytotoxicity Assay Using xCELLigence Platform
author: Kristin Anderson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sqkeduw
materials: Use RTCA and xIMT software for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare and Test E-VIEW Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the E-VIEW plate and verify the xCELLigence MP cradle functionality.

substeps.instruction: Add 50ul media to each well of the E-VIEW plate using the 'inverse pipetting' technique to avoid bubbles.
Place the plate in the xCELLigence MP cradle.
Run the setup step of the xCELLigence software to confirm all wells and connections on the cradle are functioning properly.

steps.title: Prepare Target Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend adherent tumor target cells at a concentration of 10e5 cells/50ul in T cell media.

steps.title: Seed Target Cells
steps.instruction: Plate the target cells and initiate impedance recording.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate from the cradle.
Plate 10e5 adherent tumor cells (target cells) per well in plastic 96 well VIEW-E plates (100uL total volume per well) using the 'inverse pipetting' technique.
Let the plate sit in the hood for 30 minutes to allow cells to settle.
Return the plate to the xCELLigence cradle.
Begin recording impedance values at the desired time interval.

steps.title: Grow Cells to Confluence
steps.instruction: Grow cells until confluence is reached, as determined by the cell index readout on the xCELLigence MP platform using RTCA data acquisition software.

steps.title: Add Effector Cells
steps.instruction: Introduce effector cells or controls to the target cell culture.

substeps.instruction: Prepare effector cells at desired concentrations for the assay.
Pause impedance readings and remove the plate from the cradle.
Add 50ul volume of transduced T cells, cytolysis control, or media only (for growth control) to each well using the 'inverse pipetting' technique.

steps.title: Monitor Cytotoxicity
steps.instruction: Resume impedance recording and maintain the culture.

substeps.instruction: Return the E-VIEW plate to the xCELLigence cradle and resume recording impedance values until the desired stopping point.
If the assay runs for more than 2-3 days, pause the instrument, remove the plates, and add 25-50ul of additional media to prevent wells from drying out.
